capabilities: find links to external images in notes
download external images into a vault subdirectory
rewrite image links to reference the local files
process the active note or all notes via commands
automatically process pasted external links when enabled in settings
extras: README warns the plugin is still young and that backups are a good idea; it is for Obsidian desktop and was not tested on mobile.
intentEvidence: This plugin was developed from niekcandaele's code base.
problem: Images hotlinked from the web disappear when pages move or expire, so notes that copy web content lose their images over time.

relations.evidence: This plugin was developed from niekcandaele's code base.

summary: Downloads external images referenced in notes into the vault and rewrites their links to point to the saved local files.
